title: COMP-03 Hermes-style LongMemEval-S answer comparison
read: fathomdb-fts-pack 0.856 vs lancedb-fts 0.784 answer accuracy on 250 paired questions (difference +0.072, bootstrap 95% +0.028..+0.116)

arms.setup: fathomdb_test_setup, embedder none, cpu; plain round bodies (v1 store shape)

arms.method: table.search(query_type='fts'), native FTS index, library defaults

claim_boundary.statement: paired answer accuracy on 250 LongMemEval-S questions in the full-500 type mix: FathomDB FTS (pack_context T5/A0/k50, query stop words had/long/suggest) minus LanceDB FTS (Slice 40 mix renderer); each arm keeps its own renderer, so this compares shipped paths, not stores
claim_boundary.reuse: the pinned 60 reuse the M3 (pa-m3) and mix (comp03-run-mix) answers when reader, judge, seeds, prompts and evidence policy match; reused answers are marked in the receipt

document_unit.blank_rounds: blank (whitespace-only) rounds are not indexed by any arm; round IDs stay positional, so every other round's ID and the gold are unchanged; the count is recorded per question as blank_rounds_skipped
document_unit.rule: one user turn plus the assistant turns that follow it; leading assistant turns form their own round

judge.prompt: LongMemEval evaluate_qa per-type answer check, blinded to product

live.ceiling_rule: before a question that needs any model call, stop if this run's spend (reused calls excluded) plus max(question_usd_estimate, the largest per-question spend so far) exceeds ceiling_usd; rerun to resume

retrieval.order: arms rotate by question position: arm_order(index, arms) = arms[index % n:] + arms[:index % n]; for two arms this is v1's AB/BA alternation
retrieval.per_arm: each arm's top_k is its retrieval depth; retrieval metrics use top_k 10

selection.rule: the 60 pinned answer-set IDs first, in their order; then, for each type in name order, sorted(random.Random(f'{seed}:{type}').sample(sorted IDs of the type not already pinned, quota - pinned of the type)). Abstention questions are members of their type, as in the 60-set rule.
selection.rounding: quota_t = floor(250 * n_t / 500), then the leftover questions go one each to the largest fractional parts, ties broken by type name ascending (largest-remainder rounding)
